subject: getting a raise and avoiding lifestyle creep
title: Raise means more, watch out for the trap
body: I'm 41 and I've seen what happens when you get a raise. It's tempting to immediately upgrade spending, but that's where most folks mess up. My advice is to treat the extra money like a buffer, not a new baseline for living. Keep the essentials the same and put a good chunk into savings first. Lifestyle creep is a sneaky thing that eats up all the good gains.

body: Hey everyone I'm still figuring things out with selling at the farmers market. I noticed that people really responded to having a clear story behind what I was selling.
